t: For expenses incident to the care, operation, maintenance, improvement and protection of the federally owned civil airports in the vicinity of the District of Columbia, including purchase of seven passenger motor vehicles for police use, for replacement only, which may exceed by $300 the general purchase price limitation for the current fiscal year; purchase, cleaning and repair of uniforms; and arms and ammunition; $8,500,000.

fable.w: This is a plain appropriation for operating and maintaining federally owned airports, including vehicle, uniform and ammunition purchases. There is no tempting participation reading: it names no outside party, hearing, comment process, advisory body, rulemaking or right to sue. Nothing in it brings anyone outside the federal government into a federal decision.
fable.s: For expenses incident to the care, operation, maintenance, improvement and protection of the federally owned civil airports in the vicinity of the District of Columbia

qwen_chat.w: This section is an appropriation clause authorizing funds for the operation and maintenance of federally owned airports. It lists specific expenses such as vehicle purchases, uniforms, and ammunition. There is no requirement for consultation, coordination, or participation with any outside parties (such as the public, states, or private entities) in the decision-making process regarding these expenditures. The actors involved are internal federal entities (the government spending money on its own airports).
